title: Senior AI Engineer (LLM)
highlight: Architect document intelligence RAG pipelines, multimodal vision extraction, and zero-hallucination citation engines for high-stakes enterprise documents
overview:
Trinity AI Boston builds AI products for professionals who work with large volumes of complex documents, starting with legal teams. Our platform ingests long, messy case files, extracts the facts that matter, and backs every answer with a citation to the exact source text. A human expert reviews and approves the output before it is used.

We are hiring a Senior AI Engineer to help architect and build our document intelligence engine. This is not a standard data science role. It is a systems engineering role focused on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), document understanding, and production reliability.

The ideal candidate is a builder who can design end-to-end pipelines that ingest messy PDFs (100+ pages), scanned records, and audio; extract specific data points with high precision; and provide audit-ready citations that link each answer back to its source. You will design model-agnostic components so LLMs can be swapped as the field moves, fine-tune open-weight models where they beat general-purpose ones, build guardrails and evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy against expert-reviewed data, and design human-in-the-loop and agentic workflows that keep experts in control. You will work alongside our AI Lead Engineer, mentor other engineers, and collaborate closely with our full-stack and DevSecOps engineers.

stack.Vector & Retrieval: Qdrant, Semantic & Parent-Child Chunking, Hybrid Search, Re-ranking
stack.Multimodal & Vision: Mistral OCR, LightOn, Layout Models, Vision-Capable LLMs
stack.Models & Adaptation: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Open-Weight (Llama, Qwen, Mistral), LoRA/PEFT, vLLM, Triton

responsibilities: AI Systems: Architect the RAG pipeline — design and build the end-to-end system for document ingestion, chunking, retrieval, and generation in Python.

AI Systems: Intelligent Document Processing — use modern multimodal and vision pipelines (e.g., OCR models such as Mistral OCR or LightOn, layout models, or vision-capable LLMs) to extract complex data from tables, forms, scanned pages, and handwriting. Map extracted text back to its exact location on the PDF for UI highlighting.
AI Systems: Minimize hallucination — implement validation layers, guardrails, and confidence scoring so the system does not invent data.
AI Systems: Design human-in-the-loop workflows — build review gates where experts approve, correct, or reject AI output, and capture that feedback to improve the system.
AI Systems: Process audio and video — build speech-to-text pipelines (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) for recordings such as interviews and depositions, with timestamps that link back to the source.
AI Systems: Build agentic workflows — automate multi-step tasks (gathering, extracting, cross-checking, drafting) that run ahead of human approval.
AI Systems: Build evaluation frameworks — create automated testing pipelines (Ragas, TruLens, or custom) to measure and improve accuracy against expert-reviewed gold-standard datasets.
AI Systems: Design for model independence — build LLM-agnostic interfaces so models and providers can be swapped or combined without rewriting the pipeline.
AI Systems: Fine-tune models — train and adapt open-weight models (e.g., LoRA/PEFT) on domain data where they outperform general-purpose models on accuracy or cost.
AI Systems: Optimize for scale and cost — select the right mix of models, such as frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) for reasoning and smaller or fine-tuned open-weight models for extraction.
AI Systems: Protect client data — keep each customer's data, and any customer-specific models, fully isolated.
Leadership: Contribute to AI architecture and technical direction with the AI Lead Engineer.
Leadership: Mentor AI engineers and help set coding, review, and evaluation standards.
Leadership: Work with product and domain experts to turn real workflows into measurable AI requirements.
requirements: 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on Python, including production backend services (FastAPI or similar) and structured outputs with Pydantic.
Production LLM experience: has shipped LLM applications to production, including prompt design, tool calling, and structured outputs.
Hands-on experience with a vector database in production (Qdrant preferred).
Advanced RAG techniques: deep understanding of chunking strategies (semantic chunking, parent-child retrieval), hybrid search (keyword plus semantic), and re-ranking.
Vision and layout models: experience with models that understand document structure (tables, forms, checkboxes), not just plain text.
Evaluation mindset: has built test sets and metrics to measure LLM output quality, not just demos.
Experience leading or mentoring engineers.
preferredQualifications: Domain experience with document-heavy, regulated work: legal, insurance, healthcare, or financial services.
Fine-tuning open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) on custom datasets, including LoRA/PEFT.
Self-hosting and serving open-weight OCR, speech, or language models on GPUs (e.g., vLLM, Triton).
AWS experience (S3, SQS, RDS), asynchronous job processing, and containerized deployments.
Experience building human-in-the-loop or active-learning systems.
whyThisRole: Build core AI capabilities for a product used on real, high-stakes professional work.
Hard, interesting problems: long documents, precise extraction, and citations that must hold up to expert scrutiny.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React / Python)
highlight: Build next-generation Human-in-the-Loop review workbenches combining Next.js, FastAPI, and real-time AI workflows
overview:
We are building a next-generation Human-in-the-Loop Risk Intelligence Platform that combines AI, document understanding, and real-time review workflows. The platform helps enterprises process, analyze, and validate complex documents through a review workbench powered by modern web technologies and AI-driven insights.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep React and TypeScript skills who enjoys building high-performance, data-intensive, interactive web applications.

stack.Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PostgreSQL, Redis
stack.AI/ML Services: FastAPI, Pydantic, OpenAI, Qdrant vector database

responsibilities: Build and scale complex web applications using Next.js, React and TypeScript
Develop interactive document review and annotation interfaces
Design scalable frontend architecture and state management
Build and extend backend APIs in FastAPI with PostgreSQL
Integrate the frontend with backend and AI/ML services
Work with async processing (SQS workers), caching (Redis) and file storage (S3)
Collaborate with AI/ML and backend teams to deliver intelligent user workflows
Optimize performance for large datasets and real-time interactions
requirements: 4+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
Experience with Next.js (App Router preferred)
Proven experience building complex, production-grade web applications
Strong understanding of state management (Redux, Zustand, Context API, or similar)
Experience building or integrating REST APIs; Python/FastAPI preferred
Working knowledge of SQL databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
Solid grasp of frontend performance optimization (rendering, large datasets, memoization, virtualization)
Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset

title: Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer
highlight: Own cloud environment end-to-end, enforce strict US data residency, and lead SOC 2 Type II certification for Cosmos One
overview:
Cosmos One is a cloud-based legal software platform for Florida property insurance defense attorneys. It processes confidential case documents using AI and requires strict security, data privacy, and compliance controls throughout.

This is our first dedicated infrastructure hire. You will own the cloud environment end-to-end: design, security, deployment, and ongoing operations. You will work directly alongside a full-stack engineer and an AI engineer.

You will also lead our path to SOC 2 Type II certification (a formal third-party security audit required by enterprise legal clients).
responsibilities: Cloud Infrastructure: Set up and manage our cloud environment on AWS or Azure. All data must remain in US regions (a legal requirement for our clients)
Cloud Infrastructure: Ensure complete separation between law firm accounts. No data from one client can ever be accessible by another
Cloud Infrastructure: Manage encryption of all data, both stored and in transit; own the encryption key lifecycle including key rotation and secure deletion when a case closes
Cloud Infrastructure: Design file storage for legal documents, including a 7-year retention requirement for clients not using their own document management system
Cloud Infrastructure: Define our disaster recovery plan: how quickly we can restore service after an outage, and how much data we can afford to lose
Deployment & Automation: Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) with security checks built in at every stage
Deployment & Automation: Define all infrastructure in code using Terraform or AWS Cloud Development Kit (no manual cloud console configuration)
Deployment & Automation: Set up monitoring, alerting, and logging so we can detect and respond to incidents quickly
Deployment & Automation: Manage our integrations with third-party AI model providers; ensure vendor contracts prohibit training on our client data
Security & Compliance: Lead our SOC 2 Type II readiness program: gap analysis, control documentation, evidence collection, and working with external auditors
Security & Compliance: Own our incident response plan, including the 30-day breach notification requirement
Security & Compliance: Implement an immutable audit log: every attorney approval is recorded and cannot be altered after the fact
Security & Compliance: Review and approve all third-party vendors against our security and data residency requirements
Security & Compliance: Conduct regular security reviews and manage vulnerability patching
requirements: 5–8 years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and security experience
Strong AWS or Azure experience in production, multi-tenant Software-as-a-Service environments
Experience defining infrastructure in code (Terraform and/or AWS Cloud Development Kit)
Hands-on experience building automated deployment pipelines with integrated security scanning
Has been through at least one SOC 2 Type II audit, ideally as the primary infrastructure owner
Solid grasp of encryption: key management, key rotation, and enforcing data residency
Experience with regulated data environments: legal, healthcare, or financial services
Clear written communication. An early deliverable is a Security and Infrastructure Plan that must be approved before development begins
